application_rule: Evaluate dimensions on canonical components, decisions, waves and ContextPacks; do not replicate them onto every raw source node.

dimensions.description: Which durable goal, checkpoint and acceptance criterion does this decision advance?
dimensions.name: Mission / goal

dimensions.description: What source paths, commits, tests and evidence prove the modeled fact?
dimensions.name: Provenance / evidence

dimensions.description: Where does this surface live across repositories, packages, modules and graphs?
dimensions.name: Source topology

dimensions.description: What behavior is actually provided, with what inputs, outputs and semantics?
dimensions.name: Capability semantics

dimensions.description: What does this surface require and what depends on it?
dimensions.name: Dependency graph

dimensions.description: Which runtime, process, adapter or device owns execution and lifecycle?
dimensions.name: Runtime ownership

dimensions.description: Which API, route, command, event, registry or protocol exposes the behavior?
dimensions.name: Interface contracts

dimensions.description: What durable, cached or transactional state does the behavior read or mutate?
dimensions.name: State / data

dimensions.description: How does the behavior create, retrieve, derive or consolidate memory/knowledge?
dimensions.name: Memory / knowledge

dimensions.description: How do goals, plans, routing and control flow reach this surface?
dimensions.name: Intent / control

dimensions.description: What startup, shutdown, leasing, scheduling and concurrency semantics apply?
dimensions.name: Lifecycle / concurrency

dimensions.description: What external effects occur and how are retries, receipts and idempotency handled?
dimensions.name: Side effect / idempotency

dimensions.description: What trust boundary, permission, secret, sandbox or policy gate protects it?
dimensions.name: Security / permission

dimensions.description: How does it fail, degrade, retry, roll back and recover after process or network loss?
dimensions.name: Failure / recovery

dimensions.description: Which health, latency, cost, energy and telemetry signals make behavior observable?
dimensions.name: Observability / economics

dimensions.description: Which tests or evaluations prove behavior and parity rather than implementation presence?
dimensions.name: Test / eval / parity

dimensions.description: Which OS, hardware, device, BLE, firmware or platform constraints apply?
dimensions.name: Platform / device

dimensions.description: How is the behavior presented or controlled through desktop, mobile, voice or visual embodiment?
dimensions.name: Embodiment / UX

dimensions.description: Which manifests, licenses, builds, releases, dependencies and deployment constraints apply?
dimensions.name: Supply chain / deployment

dimensions.description: How can upstream versions, state, capability availability or contracts drift over time?
dimensions.name: Temporal / drift
